title: ReconFormer: Accelerated MRI Reconstruction Using Recurrent Transformer
grouping: Three lettered panels without frames: (a) fills the top band, (b) and (c) share the bottom row. In (a) three scale heads are stacked vertically, rows labelled 'Scale Head 1-3', columns headed Query, Key, Value, each head's query-key pair closed by thin square brackets. One colour per head (green, orange, blue) groups everything that belongs to that scale.
shapes_depth: (a) starts from an MRI slice thumbnail with a white patch grid and translucent coloured squares of three sizes laid on it. Q, K and V are outlined 3-D wireframe cuboids subdivided into more cells as the scale grows; after attention the heads become solid coloured 3-D bars side by side with a vertical ellipsis, and a linear layer turns them into grey bars. (b) uses flat yellow-orange rounded boxes for K, Q, V with circled x and +, recurrent states c^(t), h^(t) as math, and italic labels ('SoftMax', 'Linear') on the arrows. (c) is a transformer layer of tall narrow white boxes with rotated labels (LayerNorm, RSA, MLP) and residual loops beneath to circled +.
proposed_highlight: The scale colours carry the idea: each head's colour is used on its patches over the scan, on its Q/K/V cuboids and again on its slot in the concatenated token row.
lesson: Give each attention scale one colour and carry it from that scale's patches on the input scan, through its Q/K/V cuboids, into its slot of the concatenated token row.
notes: Venue and year from Semantic Scholar.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
